main_text.p: INtestatorum hereditates primù ad suos heredes pertinent. Sui autem heredes appellantur, filius filia, nepos neptis, pronepos proneptis ex nepote: quia omnes per virilem sexum descendentes, sui vocantur. Naturales sunt hæ personæ, ac adoptivæ. Adoptivorum enim comparatione legitimi naturales appellantur. Sed ita nepos vel neptis ex filio suo sui heredes sunt; si pater eorum de potestate patris, aut morte aut emancipatione discesserit: nam si eo tempore, quo aliquis moritur, filium in potestate habeat, & ex eo nepotes, illi vivo patre suo, & in po-
main_text.notes: The first letter I is a large woodcut initial, rendered as plain I with the rest of the word. Lines of the grey block are printed in smaller italic type and read as marginal summary lines; they are set full width and so are transcribed as lines of the main text. The grey block has no printed heading. Some words in the grey block are faint and are read with reasonable confidence. The word "Intestatorum" in the body is printed as "INtestatorum" in the scan.
